title: The Book came down on a night that decides things.
subtitle: Why the night of revelation is named Al-Qadr
then: The people of Makkah treated the Quran as a disaster that had landed on them. Allah answers: {idea}We sent it down{/idea}, and on a night of decree in Ramadan. Ibn Abbas said it came down whole to the lowest heaven, then {reward}in parts over twenty-three years{/reward}.
now: The Quran app sits on your phone between the weather and the bank. You open it when you have a spare minute. This verse says the thing on that screen arrived on {idea}a night that changed the destiny of the world{/idea}.
old: The Quran is a book I should read more when I have time.
new: The Quran is the reason a single night became the greatest of nights.
try: Before you read today, pause and remember where these words came from. Then read just one verse slowly.

title: You do not yet know what this night is.
subtitle: A question that makes you lean in

row.title: the listener
sub: thinks a night is a night

key.label: Two ways to see a night

then: After naming the night, Allah does not explain it straight away. He asks a question. Ibn Kathir says this is how {idea}Allah magnified the status of the Night of Al-Qadr{/idea}, the night He chose for the Quran.
now: You scroll past the last ten nights of Ramadan in your calendar like any other week. Work, dinner, sleep. The verse stops you with a question: {trap}do you really know what this night is?{/trap} Most of us do not.
old: Every night is basically the same as the one before.
new: Some nights carry a weight I cannot measure. Allah tells me to pay attention.
try: Find out when the last ten nights of the next Ramadan fall and put a gentle reminder in your calendar.

title: One night outweighs more than eighty years.
subtitle: Worship that counts more than a lifetime
then: Ibn Kathir says worship on this night is like {reward}worship for a thousand months{/reward}. The Prophet ﷺ said whoever stands in prayer on it with faith, hoping for reward, has his past sins forgiven, and {trap}whoever is deprived of its good is truly deprived{/trap}.
now: You feel behind. Years lost to busyness, prayers missed, a past you are not proud of. This verse says one sincere night can carry {reward}more weight than a whole life{/reward}. Nobody is too far behind to catch up.
old: I have wasted too many years to make up for them now.
new: Allah gives a night worth a lifetime, so it is never too late to start.
try: Tonight, give five quiet minutes to prayer or dua as if it were that night.

title: That night, the angels fill the earth.
subtitle: Angels and Jibril descend with every decree
then: Ibn Kathir says the angels descend in abundance because the night's blessings are abundant, just as they {idea}surround circles of remembrance{/idea}. The Ruh is Jibril. Qatadah said {reward}life spans and provisions are measured out{/reward} on this night.
now: You sit alone on a prayer mat in a dark living room while everyone sleeps. It feels like nobody sees. On this night the room is {idea}crowded with angels{/idea}, and what is written for your year is being settled.
old: When I pray alone at night, it is just me in an empty room.
new: Where Allah is remembered, the angels come. I am never as alone as it looks.
try: Make one dua tonight for the coming year: your health, your work, your family.

title: Peace, all night long, until the dawn breaks.
subtitle: A night with no evil in it
then: Mujahid said it is {reward}security in which Shaytan cannot do any evil{/reward}. Qatadah said all of it is good until Fajr. Ash-Sha'bi said the angels {idea}greet the people in the masjids with peace{/idea} until dawn.
now: Your head is noisy. The bills, the argument from last week, the news. Imagine a whole night where {reward}none of that has power over you{/reward}. This verse promises a night like that, and it lasts right up to the first light.
old: Peace is something I get only when my problems are solved.
new: Allah can wrap a whole night in peace, even while my problems still exist.
try: Before sleeping, say salam softly to yourself and those at home, and leave your phone in another room.
